label: HALO CRYSTAL animation sheet, six frames (v2: 4–6 per animation)

transform.layout: 2 rows x 3, read left to right then the bottom row
transform.key: RGB 37,239,0 (the winner's border mode); every non-subject pixel is exactly this
transform.separation: connected components (8-way) of RGB distance to the key > 45: the core (largest) and six satellites; 6 stray single pixels dropped
transform.despill: G clamped to max(R, B) on subject pixels (only the 1-2 px edge blend changes)
transform.orbit: clockwise around the ring centre (y 515.96, x 512.49 in the winner), frame k at (k-1) x 10 degrees; each satellite moves from its drawn hexagon corner toward the next corner clockwise in polar coordinates (angle + gap/6, i.e. 10.02/10.02/9.89/10.06/10.12/9.88 degrees; radius linear), so the 7th step lands exactly on frame 1 and the loop closes
transform.satelliteSpin: each satellite turns with its orbit (rotated by the same angle about its own centroid) and keeps pointing outward
transform.core: fixed, pixel-copied; frame 1 is the winner's core unchanged; frames 2-6 add a faint two-step shine band (22 %% / 45 %% lighten toward the core's own brightest lilac, outline untouched) that steps across the gem from upper left to lower right
transform.resampling: satellites turned bilinearly at the winner's resolution; each whole frame area-averaged (Pillow BOX) by 416/928 = 0.4483 with premultiplied alpha; alpha thresholded at 0.5, so edges are binary on the key
